description: This Java source file defines the ShopContentController class, a Spring MVC controller responsible for handling HTTP requests related to displaying content pages within a shopping web application. It processes URL patterns, retrieves content descriptions, manages page metadata, and determines the appropriate view template for rendering content.

classes.name: ShopContentController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller that handles requests for displaying shop content pages based on friendly URLs, setting page metadata, and selecting the appropriate view template.

methods.name: displayContent
methods.description: Handles GET requests for content pages identified by a friendly URL, retrieves content description from the service, sets page metadata, and returns the corresponding view template name.
